$note: The WHOLE thing you write — an additive scoring model over one `fact`. `baseline` is the starting score; each characteristic (a `field`) adds the `points` of its first matching `band`. A band is { when?, points }; `when` uses the SAME condition grammar as everywhere else — a bare literal (eq), or {eq|ne|gt|gte|lt|lte: value}, or {between:[a,b]}; omit `when` for a catch-all (put it last). The total is written to the `score` field. fromEngineProject generates the Business Central .scgd (ScoreCardModel XML — best-effort: well-formed, BC-load not verified). Runtime: evaluateScorecard sums baseline + matched bands and sets the score field (functions/scorecard.mjs). Since it's additive scoring, a DRL ruleset (a rule per band) is the guaranteed-executable path. Field types derived from the declared fact. See scenarios.md §0.
